reference.geometry: At rendered frame f, an 8 by 8 rectangle covers [4+f,12+f) by [4,12); every pixel has exact zero or full area coverage.
reference.timing: step=floor(active_ms*1024/1000); lvgl_frame=floor(step*16/1024); rendered_frame=min(lvgl_frame,15). The out frame 16 is exclusive.
reference.opacity: The 25 and 100 percent keyframe endpoints truncate to 63 and 255; alpha(f)=floor(63+192*f/16).
reference.source_over: floor((foreground*alpha+background*(255-alpha))/255); foreground=[255,128,0] from nearest-integer Lottie color conversion.
reference.tolerance: Painted RGB channels allow 2 levels for premultiplication and image-compositor integer quantization. Unpainted background and output alpha are exact.
reference.terminal: At active_ms=1000, LVGL requests frame 16 and ThorVG renders frame 15; the reference is the completed pass before a later repeat timer update.
